controls: Same Assistant, relationship, session, retained facts, profile and current utterance.
Clear only disposable in-memory conversation history before every sample to prevent previous output from changing the next input.
Automatic-memory and reflection background workers stopped equally for both measured conditions; retained memory consent stays enabled, enqueue/read/privacy paths remain real.
Clear disposable queued extraction jobs before each sample so the paused worker queue has identical depth; no background-pressure claim.
Feature configuration changes occur outside the timed interval through the normal authenticated API.
Provider service remains warm; exact prompt cache is uncontrolled and pair order alternates.
No request retry, result removal or regenerated sample. Warmups are retained separately.
scope: Real authenticated HTTP/SSE, prepared context, optional selection and existing selected inference; warm service and no worker/provider background pressure. Synthetic supported-memory/workspace setup is not learned-state evidence. First non-whitespace text may not yet be useful answer text.
exclusions: No physical or synthetic audio in this study.
No browser rendering; normal authenticated HTTP/SSE path is exercised.
No cold-cache, GPU/background pressure, large-corpus or cancellation claim.
First non-whitespace text timing is an instrumentation milestone; human usefulness/quality is not established.
The inference contract has no pinned request seed; output variation is retained.
No whole LS-PERF-060-062 or S086 pass; missing audio, cold, growth, pressure, invalidation and Human claims remain separate.
Original failure records, prior causal studies and voice latency targets are unchanged.
interpretation: First-text and local preparation distributions meet their numerical targets in the observed subset. Completion failures remain aggregate failures. Complete-case bootstrap excludes only pairs without a first-text milestone for its numerical interval, not from the study result.
